text:
All fixed and verified:

- `slugify("Hello,  World!")` → `"hello-world"` ✓
- `slugify("--a--b--")` → `"a-b"` ✓
- Edge cases (`---` → `""`, leading/trailing spaces) behave correctly
- Test suite passes (2/2)

The fix: changed the regex `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+` so runs of non-alphanumeric characters collapse into a single hyphen, and added `.strip("-")` to remove any leading/trailing hyphens. The public signature is unchanged.

arguments.summary: Fixed `slugify` in textkit/slug.py by changing the substitution regex from `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+` (collapsing consecutive non-alphanumeric characters into a single hyphen) and appending `.strip("-")` to remove leading/trailing hyphens. This makes `slugify("Hello,  World!")` return `"hello-world...
